title: Accessible A2UI settings composition and honest visual evidence
summary: Settings quality requires native navigation, explicit label associations, container-aware editing layouts and separate evidence for rendered appearance.
reusable_steps: Settings quality requires native navigation, explicit label associations, container-aware editing layouts and separate evidence for rendered appearance
expected_outcome: Use grouped native links for settings navigation, preserve modifier clicks and stable section order, and retain drafts while moving between sections. Give each settings group a unique heading ID. Connect the visible row label to one supported input using explicit aria-labelledby while keeping help/error descriptions. Provide a full-width stacked layout for prose and stack narrow cards according to container width rather than viewport width alone. Validate catalog/schema registration and React/vanilla parity using realistic localized fixtures. Compare the complete application shell in light/dark and intermediate widths. Static HTML generation and passing DOM tests do not prove rendered visual quality; record approval-blocked browser checks as unverified. See knowledge/product/orchestration/a2ui-settings-design-playbook.md for the reusable procedure.
